author: neuropolimer
name: AccessRoleCheck
short: Keeps a visual access role in sync with configured key roles.
description: Automatically grants a configured access role only when a member has at least one explicitly configured key role and removes it when no key roles remain. Handles joins, role changes, deleted/stale key roles, access-role replacement, startup reconciliation, and full manual synchronization. Effective channel permissions and ownership are intentionally ignored.
install_msg: Loaded `accessrolecheck`. Configure it with `[p]accessrole set @AccessRole`, add key roles with `[p]accessrole addkey @KeyRole`, then use `[p]accessrole sync` if needed. Existing members are reconciled automatically on configuration changes and startup.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store end-user data. It only stores guild configuration containing role IDs.
